sections.Profile:
"Speed Way" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company in September 1948. Designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features two flippers, five passive bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
